events.title: Strait of Hormuz CLOSED Day 162 - Iran issues 6 demands, Iran-Oman corridor deal close but conditions attached
events.source: ISW, CBS, Fox News, Wikipedia, Iran FM Araghchi
events.summary: Hormuz remains closed Day 162. Iran FM Araghchi says Iran-Oman close to temporary transit route deal. SNSC Secretary Zolghadr issued 6 conditions for reopening: lift naval blockade, withdraw military, lift sanctions, unfreeze assets, pay reparations, cease threats. State Dept sanctioned 6 entities + 1 individual for Iran crypto funds. Iran parliament bill to ban US/Israeli vessels. Brent ~$83. Gold approaching $4,300.
events.status_change: Evolving - Iran-Oman corridor deal close but Iran attaches 6 preconditions, US sanctions crypto entities

events.title: US-Japan yen intervention $75-85B total - Bessent notepad controversy, 1997-style Asian devaluation fears
events.source: OMFIF, Reuters Breakingviews, Irish Times, BOOM Finance
events.summary: OMFIF estimates Japanese intervention ~$75B + US $5-10B. Bessent notepad photograph controversy - admitted US Treasury involvement. Irish Times: Bessent fears 1997-style competitive devaluations, wants Japan to avoid dumping US Treasuries. US Treasury allegedly used Euros not Dollars to avoid weakening dollar. Yen surges below 161. Carry trade unwind risk elevated.
events.status_change: Evolving - Bessent notepad controversy, alleged Euro-funded intervention, 1997-style fears confirmed

events.title: Ebola outbreak tops 4,000 confirmed cases - MSF warns alarming spread, US tightens travel restrictions
events.source: Outbreak News Today, ReliefWeb, Regional Media News, Punch, WHO
events.summary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) now >4,000 confirmed cases, 17th outbreak in DRC history. MSF warned Aug 5 of alarming spread. US tightened travel restrictions for passengers from Uganda, South Sudan, DRC. WHO DG and Africa CDC conducted joint mission Aug 4-5 to Uganda and DRC. Uganda: 20 confirmed cases, 2 deaths, no new since June 21. No licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo strain.
events.status_change: Worsening - crossed 4,000 cases milestone, US travel restrictions, MSF alarming spread warning

events.title: Sudan civil war 14M displaced + Nigeria-South Africa 178K deportations xenophobic crisis deepening
events.source: Wikipedia, Arab News, Rio Times, The Gazelle News
events.summary: Sudan: 14M+ forcibly displaced, 4.5M refugees - one of largest displacement crises globally. Nigeria-SA crisis: 178K+ immigrants fled or deported from South Africa. Mozambicans killed, Nigeria and Ghana claim citizens killed. Fani-Kayode appointed to protect Nigerian interests in SA. Sudan banking confidence crisis worsening.
events.status_change: Worsening - 178K deportations confirmed, Sudan displacement at 14M, diplomatic crisis deepening

events.title: ECB rate hold at 2.25% + German bunds above 3% + Europe energy grid stress + UK gilt volatility
events.source: House of Commons Library, Financial News, MoneyWeek
events.summary: ECB held rates at 2.25% after 8 cuts Jun24-Jun25 then pause. DE10Y above 3.0%. UK 10Y gilt yield ~4.89-4.95%, volatile on Burnham fiscal flexibility remarks. MoneyWeek: bond market will burn Burnham. UK CPI 2.6% above 2% target, BoE expected to hold. Eurozone GDP beat 0.4% QoQ vs 0.2% consensus.
events.status_change: Ongoing - UK gilt volatility on Burnham fiscal remarks, ECB hold confirmed, EU GDP beat

events.title: NEW: British Columbia declares provincial state of emergency - wildfires spreading
events.source: CBC News, EmergencyInfoBC, NYT, BC Wildfire Service
events.summary: BC declared province-wide state of emergency Aug 8 due to regional wildfires. Officials warn more challenging fire behaviour ahead. NYT: wildfire crisis shifted westward, evacuations triggered. Ontario fires earlier choked cities to the south. This is a new climate-stress event escalating to emergency level.
events.status_change: NEW EVENT - BC provincial state of emergency declared, wildfire crisis escalating

events.title: Fed: 3 dissenters want hike, markets pricing 77% September hike odds, CPI Aug 13-14 key
events.source: Trading Economics, Fox Business, Newsquawk, Polymarket
events.summary: July FOMC held at 3.5-3.75%. 3 governors dissented wanting 25bp hike. Markets now pricing 77% probability of September hike. Polymarket live on September decision. Next CPI Aug 13-14 key data point. Pantheon: August inflation more likely to bear on September decision. 30Y Treasury yield hit 5.28% in July, highest since 2007.
events.status_change: Elevated - September hike odds at 77%, 30Y at 5.28% highest since 2007

events.title: Argentina-Brazil crisis worst in four decades - country risk 451, Xinhua reports electoral interference
events.source: Prensa Mercosur, Rio Times, Xinhua, Buenos Aires Herald
events.summary: Prensa Mercosur: Argentina-Brazil relations at most delicate point in four decades. Argentina country risk climbed to 451 bps, Merval fell 6th day. Brazil withdrew ambassador. Xinhua: crisis represents orchestrated electoral interference by conservative international from US. Brazil markets pricing Lula 4, UBS warns 2027 fiscal reckoning. Real at R$5.13/$.
events.status_change: Worsening - worst crisis in 4 decades per Prensa Mercosur, Xinhua reports electoral interference angle

events.title: India RBI intervenes to shield rupee at 95.28 - Raghuram Rajan warns on oil reserves
events.source: Reuters, Times of India, Economic Times, SEBI
events.summary: Rupee at 95.28/$. RBI intervening to shield from oil price jump. Rajan warns India needs larger strategic oil reserves and diversified imports. SEBI: India markets supported by resilient fundamentals but global risks elevated. Philippine energy crisis from Hormuz closure. South Korea extreme heat spreading to Seoul.
events.status_change: Elevated - RBI active intervention, rupee at 95.28, Philippine energy crisis

events.title: China FX reserves $3.42T + PBOC loose policy continues + property crisis ongoing
events.summary: China FX reserves $3.4188T end-July, +$2.5B from June. PBOC maintaining moderately loose monetary policy H2 2026. Property crisis ongoing with no resolution. Currency undervalued 20%+ per CFR. Current account surplus shifting 4pp.
events.status_change: Ongoing - FX reserves stable, PBOC loose stance unchanged, property crisis continues

events.title: UK: Burnham fiscal flexibility remarks rattle gilts + bond market will burn Burnham warning
events.source: Financial News, MoneyWeek, House of Commons Library, BBC
events.summary: New PM Burnham fiscal flexibility remarks caused gilt yield spike to 4.95%, then pulled back to 4.89% after Chancellor Healey reaction. MoneyWeek warns bond market will burn Burnham. CPI 2.6% above target. BoE 6-3 hold at 3.75%. Gilt issuance elevated, fiscal rules under pressure.
events.status_change: Elevated - Burnham gilt volatility, MoneyWeek bond market warning

events.title: HY OAS at 271bps + Russia banking crisis risk + Brazil credit clouds forming
events.source: ConvexTrade, Moscow Times, Valor Economico, BankSift
events.summary: HY OAS 271bps (below 600 stress threshold). Russia bankruptcies +13.7% YoY, wartime debt boom banking crisis risk. Brazil: Valor reports clouds forming in credit market, bank executives warning privately. US regulatory oversight gap persists. No systemic freeze but stress building.
events.status_change: Elevated - Brazil credit clouds, Russia banking stress, HY spreads contained
